name: BBC Diamond
summary: Zidane's back-to-back Champions League system. A narrow diamond that concedes the flanks on purpose, overloads the middle third, and lets two forwards and two overlapping full-backs finish everything the diamond funnels forward.
keyInstructions: Both full-backs on Wingback (Attack) — they are the only width the system has.
Holding CDM never crosses the halfway line; set him to Defend and leave him there.
The CAM on Roaming is the whole point: he drifts into the half-spaces the strikers vacate.
Balanced build-up, not Short Passing — the diamond needs the option to hit the front two directly.
weaknesses: Weak against a low block with five defenders

recommendedProfiles.note: 78+ pace, 80+ stamina. Growth wingbacks are cheap — this is the slot to spend youth on.
80+ defending and 78+ passing. Ayyoub Bouaddi's profile is the archetype.
Roaming playmaker: 85+ dribbling, 4★ skills, Incisive Pass.

name: Inverted 3-2-4-1
summary: The treble system. A right-back steps into midfield to form a double pivot, three centre-backs hold a rest-defence against the counter, and four attackers occupy the width and both half-spaces ahead of them.
keyInstructions: Short Passing build-up with a Build-Up sweeper keeper — the GK is the spare man in the first phase.
Wide attackers stay pinned to the touchline; only the two CAMs are allowed inside.
High defensive approach with narrow width (48): the three CBs cover the middle, the wide players press back.
Four in the box maximum — the double pivot must never both join the attack.
weaknesses: Punished by a long-ball direct side
Demands 80+ passing across the back three
High line exposed to 90+ pace strikers

recommendedProfiles.note: 78+ pace and 78+ passing. Pau Cubarsí and Jorrel Hato are the two best fits in the FC 27 pool.
85+ passing, Pinged Pass PlayStyle. This is the slot that breaks low blocks.
High dribbling and passing over shooting — a converted CAM outperforms a natural poacher here.

name: Leverkusen 3-4-2-1
summary: The invincible season. A patient back three that baits the press, wing-backs holding maximum width, and two free eights running beyond a target striker the moment the ball is turned over.
keyInstructions: Attacking width 72 — the wing-backs are the only players allowed outside the boxes' width.
One Holding, one Deep-Lying Playmaker in the pivot. Never two of the same.
Both CAMs on Shadow Striker: they attack the space either side of the target man on every turnover.
Balanced defensive approach keeps the line at 55 — this system counters, it does not press.
strengths: Very few tactical instructions to manage
Set-piece threat from the back three
weaknesses: Loses control against a possession side

recommendedProfiles.note: 85+ pace, 85+ stamina, 4★ weak foot. The most demanding physical slot in the game.
Kenan Yıldız and Ethan Nwaneri profiles — 85+ dribbling with real finishing.
Power Header / Aerial PlayStyle and 185cm+. Chido Obi grows into this exact role.

name: Heavy Metal 4-3-3
summary: Gegenpressing in its purest form. Win the ball back inside six seconds, attack down the outside of the full-backs, and let two inverted wingers finish from the half-spaces while the full-backs supply everything.
keyInstructions: Aggressive Press with depth 74. Your back four must average 80+ pace or you will be run in behind.
Pressing Forward striker sets the trap — everything else follows his first movement.
Both wingers Inside Forward, both full-backs attacking: the width comes from defenders, the goals from wingers.
Counter build-up, not Short Passing. The whole system is designed to score inside eight seconds of the turnover.
strengths: Forces turnovers in the final third
Simple to coach to an AI squad
weaknesses: Very exposed to a long-ball release

recommendedProfiles.note: 80+ pace mandatory. Do not run this system with a sub-75 pace CB pairing.
Antonio Nusa and Assane Diao profiles — 90+ pace, opposite-footed to their flank.
Relentless / Press Proven PlayStyles and 85+ stamina. Rotate them every third match.

name: Cholismo 4-4-2
summary: Two banks of four, twenty metres apart, moving as one unit. Concede possession, deny the centre entirely, and win the game from a set piece or one direct ball into the channel.
keyInstructions: Defensive width 38 and depth 32 — the two banks must be narrow enough to touch.
Both wide midfielders on Defend focus. They are auxiliary full-backs, not wingers.
Long Ball build-up into the target man, second ball picked up by the box-to-box eight.
Take every set piece seriously: corners and free kicks at 4 is where this system's goals come from.
strengths: Wins ugly with a weaker squad
weaknesses: Struggles to chase a two-goal deficit

recommendedProfiles.note: Aerial and Bruiser PlayStyles over pace. Giovanni Leoni is built for this exact role.
Prioritise 85+ stamina and 70+ defending over dribbling.
185cm+, Power Header. Everything the long-ball build-up produces goes through him.
